name: Aurelius Varsity Jacket
description:
A letterman-style varsity jacket with a white wool body and cognac leather sleeves — a combination that reads as timeless and deliberate. The ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem are in cream. A chenille letter patch on the left chest reads 'GLMZ' in an old athletic font. The back has a large embroidered design: a stylized skyline of the GLMZ Spire rendered in gold and white thread, with the year 2198 below it. The interior is quilted satin in ivory.

Aurelius doesn't make these for a school or a team. They make them for anyone who wants to claim the city as their identity. Tier 3 and Tier 4 buyers pick these up as lifestyle pieces. Street kids in the Gray Zone save up for them or buy counterfeits. In some neighborhoods the GLMZ patch has been adopted as informal territory marking, which Aurelius has not commented on publicly.
what_it_says: You claim this city. Whether that's civic pride or territorial assertion depends entirely on where you're wearing it.
worn_by: people who grew up in GLMZ and never left
story_hooks: The GLMZ patch has been adopted by at least two rival street factions who each claim ownership of the symbol — wearing it in the wrong neighborhood has become genuinely dangerous
Aurelius made a limited run with a different back design — the Spire shown burning — that was recalled immediately; a few survived and are worth significant money to the right collector
A Tier 4 executive is quietly buying up every authentic Aurelius varsity she can find and will not say why

physical_description.visual_profile: A classic letterman silhouette with deliberate luxury-casual positioning. The stark contrast between crisp white wool front and rich cognac leather sleeves creates visual depth and suggests both aspiration and earned status. Reads as a trophy piece — something claimed rather than assigned.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the body with structured shoulders. Sits at the natural waist with slight room for layering. Sleeves taper subtly at the wrist, anchored by ribbed cuffs. Built for movement but maintains clean lines.
physical_description.primary_material: High-grade virgin wool (body), vegetable-tanned cognac leather (sleeves), cream ribbed knit (collar, cuffs, hem). Quilted ivory satin interior.
physical_description.texture: Wool has a soft, brushed finish. Leather develops natural patina over time — subtle creasing is expected. Ribbing has tight, uniform weave. Chenille letter and embroidered back panel add subtle dimensional texture.
physical_description.color_scheme: White wool body dominates. Cognac leather sleeves provide warm, aged-bronze contrast. Cream ribbing softens transitions. Back embroidery in gold and white thread with high contrast against the white wool. GLMZ patch in dark thread on cream field.
physical_description.closures: Hidden button front — five burnished metal buttons, barely visible against white wool. Snap closures at cuffs for adjustability.
distinctive_features: Chenille 'GLMZ' patch on left chest in vintage athletic serif font
Large back embroidery: stylized GLMZ Spire skyline in gold/white with '2198' below
Cream ribbed knit collar, cuffs, hem — classical letterman proportions
Cognac leather sleeves with natural aging potential
Quilted satin interior (ivory) — hidden luxury detail
Subtle reinforced shoulder seams for durability
No visible branding beyond the GLMZ patch and back embroidery
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 aspirational / Tier 2 lifestyle purchase. Price point accessible to working professionals and skilled trade workers; collectible enough for corpo middle management as nostalgia/status flex.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer claims the city as identity rather than serving an institution. Popular among GLMZ residents who've earned their place — transit workers, local service techs, mid-tier corporate staff. The GLMZ patch adoption as informal territory marking suggests it's become a grass-roots symbol of neighborhood belonging, which creates secondary social currency on the street.
physical_description.condition_typical: Arrives pristine with structured shoulders. With wear, the leather sleeves develop character creasing and warm patina. Wool resists pilling. Quilted interior shows minimal wear. GLMZ patch remains crisp; embroidery holds color well. Owners typically keep these in rotation rather than daily wear — collectible enough to maintain, identity-significant enough to preserve.
